metadata.methods_description: EEG was recorded using a Biosemi ActiveTwo system with 128 channels plus EOG/ECG at 2048 Hz, online bandpass filtered 0.1-100 Hz. The resting-state paradigm consisted of 12 minutes with 4 minutes alternating eyes closed/open (COCO) and 8 minutes eyes closed (excluded). Preprocessing in EEGLAB/MATLAB included visual inspection, downsampling to 128 Hz, average rereferencing, FIR bandpass filtering (1-40 Hz), bad channel rejection, ASR, and ICA with ICLabel for artifact removal. Spectral features were extracted using Welch's method with 50% overlap and a Hamming window across delta, theta, alpha, and beta bands.
